levels.1: The selected route is the first Japanese amusement-machine release.
levels.2: Use an authentic 2013 Daiichi CR Biohazard cabinet.
levels.3: Verify model plate, manufacturer, cabinet art, playfield, mechanisms, firmware, and original control panel before capture. Do not substitute the later Growth or Infection specification variants.

levels.1: Two later specifications share the presentation.

levels.1: Archival completion does not require wagering.
levels.2: Use a lawfully owned cabinet configured for non-wager free play.
levels.3: Have an authorized owner follow the original operator documentation. Do not deposit money, seek payouts, bypass certified hardware, or use public gambling to trigger content.

levels.1: The screen, panel, mechanisms, lamps, and audio act together.

levels.1: Internal settings can change observed frequency.
